controls.chapter_title: Decision Classes, Authority Matrix, and Records
controls.title: Verify authority at decision time

controls.automation: Automated completeness/integrity checks plus human authority review

controls.chapter_title: Decision Classes, Authority Matrix, and Records
controls.title: Forbid vote laundering
controls.requirement: A majority, consensus, committee recommendation, or popularity signal MUST NOT substitute for the authority required by the controlling source.
controls.enforcement: workflow gate, register validation, and independent review

controls.chapter_title: Decision Classes, Authority Matrix, and Records
controls.title: Bind exact scope
controls.requirement: A decision MUST identify the exact artifact, version, environment, capability, Treaty, duration, population, and conditions it governs.
controls.enforcement: workflow gate, register validation, and independent review
controls.source: Book I Decisions 34, 40, 48, 58; Books II-III; Book VIII Chapters 1-2 and 11
controls.automation: Automated completeness/integrity checks plus human authority review

controls.chapter_title: Decision Classes, Authority Matrix, and Records
controls.title: Control effective state

controls.chapter_title: Governance Bodies, Meetings, Deliberation, and Conflicts

controls.chapter_title: Governance Bodies, Meetings, Deliberation, and Conflicts
controls.title: Preserve dissent

controls.automation: Automated completeness/integrity checks plus human authority review

controls.chapter_title: Governance Bodies, Meetings, Deliberation, and Conflicts
controls.title: Disclose conflicts

controls.enforcement: workflow gate, register validation, and independent review

controls.automation: Automated completeness/integrity checks plus human authority review

controls.chapter_title: Governance Bodies, Meetings, Deliberation, and Conflicts
controls.title: Recuse conflicted decision-makers

controls.enforcement: workflow gate, register validation, and independent review

controls.automation: Automated completeness/integrity checks plus human authority review

controls.chapter_title: Governance Bodies, Meetings, Deliberation, and Conflicts
controls.title: Protect deliberative integrity

controls.enforcement: workflow gate, register validation, and independent review

controls.automation: Automated completeness/integrity checks plus human authority review

controls.chapter_title: Governance Bodies, Meetings, Deliberation, and Conflicts

controls.enforcement: workflow gate, register validation, and independent review

controls.chapter_title: Constitutional Amendment and Stewardship Review
controls.title: Use Constitutional Change Objects

controls.chapter_title: Constitutional Amendment and Stewardship Review

controls.title: Verify before incorporation

controls.enforcement: workflow gate, register validation, and independent review

controls.automation: Automated completeness/integrity checks plus human authority review

controls.title: Preserve immutable history
controls.requirement: The signed Constitution, amendment proposal, Owner Authorization Ceremony Record, prior versions, commentary, Evidence Objects, and disposition MUST remain immutable and publicly distinguishable by status.
controls.enforcement: workflow gate, register validation, and independent review

controls.automation: Automated completeness/integrity checks plus human authority review

controls.title: Separate authority from commentary

controls.automation: Automated completeness/integrity checks plus human authority review

controls.title: Forbid emergency constitutional change

controls.title: Use break-glass controls
controls.requirement: Break-glass access MUST be identity-bound, purpose-limited, least-privilege, time-limited, dual-controlled where feasible, monitored, automatically revoked, and retrospectively reviewed.
controls.enforcement: workflow gate, register validation, and independent review
controls.source: Book I Decisions 35, 38-43, 47-51; Books II-IV; Book V operational authority; Book VI security, privacy, and trust authority

controls.title: Protect incident evidence

controls.enforcement: workflow gate, register validation, and independent review
controls.source: Book I Decisions 35, 38-43, 47-51; Books II-IV; Book V operational authority; Book VI security, privacy, and trust authority

controls.chapter_title: Operational, Security, Privacy, Incident, and Emergency Governance
controls.title: Govern privacy impact
controls.requirement: Governance decisions affecting personal or sensitive data MUST identify purpose, authority, minimization, inference, disclosure, retention, deletion, people affected, and remedy.
controls.enforcement: workflow gate, register validation, and independent review
controls.source: Book I Decisions 35, 38-43, 47-51; Books II-IV; Book V operational authority; Book VI security, privacy, and trust authority

controls.title: Coordinate cross-domain incidents

controls.chapter_title: Operational, Security, Privacy, Incident, and Emergency Governance
controls.title: Require retrospective review
controls.requirement: Every material incident or emergency exercise of exceptional authority MUST receive independent, blame-aware review of decisions, evidence, harms, recovery, authority, controls, and corrective action.
controls.enforcement: workflow gate, register validation, and independent review
controls.source: Book I Decisions 35, 38-43, 47-51; Books II-IV; Book V operational authority; Book VI security, privacy, and trust authority

controls.title: Maintain an append-only register

controls.title: Bind evidence and decision

controls.title: Minimize governance data
controls.requirement: Governance evidence MUST retain the least personal, secret, or sensitive content sufficient for accountability and MUST use references, redaction, segmentation, and access decisions.
controls.enforcement: workflow gate, register validation, and independent review

controls.chapter_title: Audit, Evidence, Publication, Confidentiality, and Retention
controls.title: Classify publication
controls.requirement: Each record MUST be classified public, canon-internal, restricted, confidential, or sealed with rationale, access authority, review date, and release condition.
controls.enforcement: workflow gate, register validation, and independent review
controls.source: Book I Articles VI, XI, XII and Decision 40; Book II evidence architecture; Books III, VIII, IX

controls.chapter_title: Audit, Evidence, Publication, Confidentiality, and Retention
controls.title: Publish authoritative status
controls.requirement: Published governance artifacts MUST state authority, version, status, effective date, supersession, scope, and canonical location so drafts cannot masquerade as authority.
controls.enforcement: workflow gate, register validation, and independent review

controls.chapter_title: Audit, Evidence, Publication, Confidentiality, and Retention
controls.title: Protect audit independence

controls.enforcement: workflow gate, register validation, and independent review

controls.title: Correct by supersession

controls.enforcement: workflow gate, register validation, and independent review

controls.title: Separate ownership succession
controls.requirement: Owner transfer or succession MUST use the constitutional procedure and MUST NOT be inferred from custody, kinship, employment, access, incapacity, or emergency role.

controls.chapter_title: Succession, Continuity, Emergency Authority, and Institutional Recovery
controls.title: Plan role succession
controls.requirement: Every critical governance role MUST define deputies, activation criteria, authority limits, term, handback, records, and disqualification conditions.
controls.enforcement: workflow gate, register validation, and independent review

controls.chapter_title: Succession, Continuity, Emergency Authority, and Institutional Recovery
controls.title: Test continuity
controls.requirement: Governance continuity plans MUST be exercised for identity compromise, unavailable Owner, unavailable authority, lost records, split authority, communication failure, and facility loss.
controls.enforcement: workflow gate, register validation, and independent review

controls.chapter_title: Succession, Continuity, Emergency Authority, and Institutional Recovery
controls.title: Restore authority before business
controls.requirement: Institutional recovery MUST verify Owner identity, constitutional state, authority records, audit integrity, and decision-register continuity before ordinary governance resumes.
controls.enforcement: workflow gate, register validation, and independent review
controls.source: Book I Decisions 47-48, 51, 58; Book II continuity/recovery architecture; Book VIII recovery assurance

controls.chapter_title: Succession, Continuity, Emergency Authority, and Institutional Recovery
controls.title: Quarantine compromised roles
controls.requirement: A suspected compromised identity, credential, device, record system, or governance body MUST lose affected decision authority while evidence is preserved and independent recovery proceeds.
controls.enforcement: workflow gate, register validation, and independent review

controls.title: Prevent self-release

controls.chapter_title: Succession, Continuity, Emergency Authority, and Institutional Recovery
controls.title: Bound emergency succession
controls.requirement: Emergency acting authority MUST be minimal, expiring, nontransferable unless expressly authorized, unable to make Owner-reserved decisions, and subject to rapid review.
controls.enforcement: workflow gate, register validation, and independent review
controls.source: Book I Decisions 47-48, 51, 58; Book II continuity/recovery architecture; Book VIII recovery assurance

controls.chapter_title: Succession, Continuity, Emergency Authority, and Institutional Recovery
controls.title: Preserve institutional memory
controls.requirement: Continuity records MUST retain charters, authorities, decisions, dissent, exceptions, appeals, certifications, Treaties, succession, and unresolved obligations across personnel and system changes.
controls.enforcement: workflow gate, register validation, and independent review

controls.title: Provide appeal notice

controls.title: Use independent appeal authority

controls.chapter_title: Appeals, Conflict Resolution, Accountability, and Conformance
controls.title: Protect critical restrictions
controls.requirement: Appeal MUST NOT automatically stay a suspension, revocation, quarantine, or fail-closed restriction protecting constitutional, authority, safety, privacy, or trust invariants.

controls.title: Resolve source conflict upward
controls.requirement: When artifacts conflict, governance MUST preserve the higher-order rule, halt the conflicting effect, record the conflict, correct the lower-order artifact, and avoid reinterpretation.

controls.title: Provide remedy
controls.requirement: Confirmed error MUST produce proportionate correction, notification, record supersession, restored rights or status where possible, and prevention of recurrence.

controls.chapter_title: Appeals, Conflict Resolution, Accountability, and Conformance
controls.title: Audit governance conformance
controls.requirement: Periodic audit MUST test authority paths, role separation, conflicts, evidence, exceptions, sunsets, appeals, publication, retention, certification status, and dependency reconciliation.
controls.enforcement: workflow gate, register validation, and independent review

controls.title: Measure outcomes, not volume
controls.requirement: Governance metrics MUST examine decision quality, reversals, calibration, escaped harms, exception age, conflict handling, burden, timeliness, participation, and remedy—not meeting or approval counts alone.
controls.enforcement: workflow gate, register validation, and independent review
